# S00 · Foundation — repo, CI, schema, auth, settings framework

[All stages](README.md) · [Wave 1](README.md#wave-1) · [README dashboard](../../README.md#all-28-stages) · [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s00--foundation--pr-1118)

> **বাংলায় — ভিত্তি — কোড, সেটিংস আর লগইন:**
> - পুরো দোকানের ডাটাবেসের নকশা একবারে বানানো, যাতে পরে ভাঙতে না হয়।
> - কোনো নাম, দাম বা নিয়ম কোডে লেখা থাকে না — সব সেটিংস থেকে আসে, অ্যাডমিন থেকে বদলানো যায়।
> - API চাবি তালাবন্ধ লকারে থাকে; স্টাফ লগইন, রোল আর পারমিশনও এই ধাপে।
> - ৬ নভেম্বর (CN-036): অ্যাডমিনের নতুন চেহারা "Lumen" এই ধাপে — থিম, মেনু, সাধারণ অংশ আর প্রতিটা সেকশন, লাইভের আগে।

**Done:** 43 / 44 PRs (In progress) · **Wave:** 1 · **PR numbers:** 11–18, 491–496, 500, 508–510, 603, 625–651, 656 · **Register status:** locked; CN-036 filed 6 Nov: 625–648 the admin look Lumen; 649–651 (three further looks) wait in the parking lot and are not counted; CN-044 filed 11 Nov: PR 656, Orders designs B/C (ERP lane, follow-up 381)

**Parking lot:** **Admin looks ক Clear Day, খ Night Atelier, গ Studio** (CN-036; S00) — 3 PRs (649–651). Decided 6 Nov 2026: only Lumen is built now. Each comes back when the owner says "build ক" (or খ, গ); the theme layer of PR 625 makes each a token set plus a shell variant.

**বাংলায়:** অ্যাডমিনের নতুন চেহারা Lumen-এর রং, ফন্ট আর চলনের ভিত্তি: হালকা রং আসল, রাতের রং প্রত্যেকের নিজের, প্রধান রং (coral) সেটিং থেকে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-06
  - Build status row: Lumen theme layer (CN-036, Lane A foundation, Launch row; batch 12; settings registry v234 `admin.theme` {look lumen, accent coral, reduceMotion off}; no migration): `app/admin/theme/lumen.css` holds every admin colour, radius, font, shadow and motion time as a `--lm-*` token, light as the default and dark on `[data-lm-mode=dark]`; the accent is mixed into every accent token so text on it stays readable; the old variables of shell.css, look.css and admin.css read the tokens; Plus Jakarta Sans and Bricolage Grotesque self-hosted (woff2); each person's light/dark, motion and accent kept on their staff account (`StaffUser.adminPrefs.theme`); hardcode guard reads .css and adds the rule `admin-style-literal` with a per-file baseline ratchet (section PRs lower it, a new file has none; on integration PR 282's calendar bar colour became a token); **follow-ups (6 Nov, #92; follow-ups 671, 672, 690):** the old admin toast's styles (`.a2-toast`, `.a2-toast-slot` with their colour literals) are gone from shell.css (guard baseline 104 → 101); contrast AA in both themes for every ready accent swatch — accent ink 72% → 66%, brand 78% → 66% (deep 62 → 56), primary button 80/70% → 70/60%, logo 70/58% (the white letter was 2.7:1), placeholders in the quieter ink: the light accent is a little darker, so all six swatches reach AA; `lib/admin-lumen/contrast.ts` and `theme/lumen-contrast.test.ts` check every text/background token pair in light, dark and the island for the six swatches and that no Lumen text is faded with opacity. Measured: the dark submenu is 7.28:1 (already AA, 672) and the Bengali sidebar fits at 1024 px (690). An accent typed in by hand is not checked yet (follow-up 718)
  - GitHub pull request #92, 6 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #86, 6 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Lumen theme layer** (CN-036; S00; Lane A foundation; `docs/demo/admin-look/LUMEN-SPEC.md` §1). One central theme layer for the admin: every colour, radius, font and shadow is a CSS variable of the look (LUMEN-SPEC §1 light and dark tokens), nothing hardcoded in any admin page (the CI hardcode guard, PR 494, gains the admin rule). Light is the default mode; dark by the moon button, remembered per user on the account. The accent colour is a setting (Settings › Admin look › Colour; coral as shipped). Self-hosted fonts, no Google Fonts call: Bricolage Grotesque (display 700/800), Plus Jakarta Sans (body), Hind Siliguri (Bengali, already in the repo). Text on cards at least 14 px, headings at least 24 px on desktop. Motion (fade, count-up 700 ms, line draw, row slide-out, switch spring) honours `prefers-reduced-motion` and a per-user "Reduce motion" setting. A new look is a token set plus an optional shell variant, so PR 649–651 stay small. The CN-025 page designs A/B/C and ADMIN2-FRAMEWORK stay exactly as built.
- **Filed under:** [CN-036 additions — the admin look Lumen and two go-live items (6 Nov 2026)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#cn-036-additions--the-admin-look-lumen-and-two-go-live-items-6-nov-2026)
